hwaccel_invalid.name: hwaccel_invalid
hwaccel_invalid.long_description: The specified hardware accelerator is invalid or not recognized by the system.

hwaccel_none.name: none
hwaccel_none.long_description: Disables hardware acceleration, using software encoding and decoding.

hwaccel_amd.name: amf
hwaccel_amd.long_description: Uses AMD's Advanced Media Framework (AMF) for hardware-accelerated media encoding and decoding.

hwaccel_nvidia.name: cuda
hwaccel_nvidia.long_description: Uses NVIDIA's CUDA and NVENC/NVDEC technologies for hardware-accelerated media processing.

hwaccel_intel.name: qsv
hwaccel_intel.long_description: Uses Intel's Quick Sync Video (QSV) for hardware-accelerated encoding and decoding.

hwaccel_vulkan.name: vulkan
hwaccel_vulkan.long_description: Uses the Vulkan API for cross-platform GPU-accelerated media processing and computation.
